districtFact: Cherry Creek School District serves families in the southeast Denver metro area, including Cherry Creek, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and parts of Aurora. Its All Schools calendar distinguishes full student-and-staff closures from K-12 non-contact days, K-8 non-contact/conference dates, and teacher work days before school starts.

about.title: About the Cherry Creek School Calendar
about.content: Cherry Creek School District publishes an All Schools calendar for districtwide planning, but the calendar is more detailed than a simple holiday list. It separates full closures from K-12 non-contact days and K-8 non-contact/conference dates, which can affect childcare, meals, transportation, and after-school arrangements differently.

about.title: Separate School and Program Calendars
about.content: The district calendar page also links separate calendars for high schools, preschool and pre-kindergarten, adaptive programs, Challenge School, innovation campuses, and alternative programs. Use the All Schools PDF for districtwide dates, then check the assigned school or program calendar for A/B days, conferences, testing, and campus-specific changes.

planningTips.title: Cherry Creek Calendar Notes
content: Blue full-closure dates apply to students and staff, while yellow K-12 non-contact dates and orange K-8 non-contact/conference dates have different program implications.
The All Schools PDF marks teacher work days before the first student day; those dates are not regular school days for students.
High school families should check their campus calendar for A/B schedules, exams, graduation, and program-specific events rather than relying only on the districtwide PDF.

CCSD may publish separate school and program calendars for high schools, preschool, adaptive programs, innovation campuses, pathways, and other specialized schedules. Check the district calendar page and your assigned school before making campus-specific plans.

districtFaqs.q: What is the Cherry Creek School District All Schools calendar?
districtFaqs.a: It is the districtwide calendar for all schools. It shows full closures, school start and end dates, teacher work days, K-12 non-contact days, and K-8 non-contact or conference dates.

districtFaqs.q: What is the difference between K-12 and K-8 non-contact days in CCSD?
districtFaqs.a: K-12 non-contact dates apply across grade levels, while K-8 non-contact or conference dates are specifically marked for elementary and middle school students. Families should read the current All Schools PDF and check the campus for program details.

districtFaqs.q: Does Cherry Creek have separate school calendars?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. CCSD publishes separate school and program calendars in addition to the All Schools calendar, including preschool, adaptive programs, Challenge School, innovation campuses, pathways, and high schools.

districtFaqs.q: Where can families verify Cherry Creek calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official CCSD calendar page and the current All Schools PDF for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Cherry Creek School District.
